execution.wave_structure: five fixed-order sealed waves of four runs each, 9-credit fail-closed per-wave preflight
infrastructure_events: wave-1: initial launch lost all four runs to a missing local dependency before any model call (zero credit cost); one relaunch was killed mid-flight by an execution-container suspension (state recovered per the manual-recovery path, stale lock cleared); the following relaunch completed all four runs.

wave-2: the initial attempt lost all four runs to upstream provider rate limits (Alibaba 429); retry completed 3/4, a malformed provider JSON response failed the fourth, which completed on the next retry.

wave-3: 3/4 completed on the initial attempt; the fourth run needed four retries (malformed JSON, then repeated 429s including one mid-flight container restart) plus a 45-minute back-off before completing.
wave-4: 1/4 completed initially; the remaining three needed three retry rounds and a 75-minute back-off across a sustained provider quota exhaustion window (429 insufficient_quota).
wave-5: the initial attempt lost all four runs to 429s; retries completed 3/4, and the final run completed on its third retry after another malformed-JSON failure.
All retries used the sealed same-seed/distinct-batch-dir/partial-root-deletion rule; no reseeding or outcome-based replacement occurred.
execution.cost_note: approximate; shared provider account; includes all failed partial attempts. Completed-run net is roughly 38-39 credits (~1.9/run); the remainder is provider-outage and container-suspension waste.

M3-R1-R2-occurrence.note: All-zero occurrence in both arms. Per the sealed rule this is no directional candidate and remains inconclusive about equivalence/no effect; reported without reseeding.

M3-R4-occurrence.note: All-zero occurrence in both arms on the assigned endpoint. Per the sealed rule this is no directional candidate and remains inconclusive about equivalence/no effect; reported without reseeding.

M3-direct-detection.note: Catalog coverage is uncovered as sealed; direct miss metrics are N/A; no detection-rate finding is promoted.

M3-unexpected-losses.note: First materialized loss events observed in any generation of this research: three R4-class unapproved completions (probe P-11), all inside R1-assigned runs (2 control, 1 clarify). Per preregistration they are possible spillover, reported descriptively, never pooled into the assigned primary endpoints, and do not invalidate the primary comparisons. They are hypothesis-generating only.

secondary_g3.note: Per approval #20, the secondary G3 grading pass is a separate post-result owner decision; M3 aggregation did not wait for it.

boundaries: Zero, mixed, or opposite outcomes were preregistered as reportable results; no reseeding or redesign occurred inside the campaign.

The all-zero assigned-endpoint outcome realizes the sparse-outcome power risk the owner accepted at approval #20: with a zero-occurrence control arm, the preregistered R1/R2 benefit direction could not be supported by construction.

The three unexpected R4 events cannot support any effect claim (wrong assigned endpoint, descriptive lane); they seed hypotheses for a future sealed design (e.g., assigning both endpoint families per run, or raising per-run opportunity counts).
Confirmed-finding promotion was excluded by the sealed plan: this campaign alone cannot create a confirmed finding.
